usage: Protocol reference only. Node Comics implements inert TypeScript HTML/JSON parsing through its existing source contracts and caller transport; upstream Kotlin/APK code is not executed or bundled.
scope: Explicitly registered Lagoon Scans, UnderTranslations and Arena Scans: public WordPress name search, complete static chapterlist, dedicated work cover, canonical and allc chapter ownership, unprotected full-mode ts_reader.run JSON with one selected image source. No source scripts, view-count POSTs, account actions, protected-page unlocks, novels, alternate randomized slugs, DOM-only or base64/obfuscated reader variants are implemented.

files.purpose: Reference for search cards, chapterlist markup, lazy image attributes and reader data. Node Comics verifies live public ?s= search pagination and strictly parses the full reader JSON instead of regex-extracting arbitrary image arrays; source view counters are not called.
